xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex70032024-10-17-14-10" status="unreviewed">gsum pa zhugs pa'i 'bras bu chos sku'i sa mtshams la gsum las gzhan lugs dgag pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4307">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">gnyal pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4307">gzas pa</rs></note> na re tshogs lam na chos sku med cing sbyor lam na sku'i tha snyad tsam yod de| chos nyid spyi'i tshul du rtogs shing spang bya mngon 'gyur spangs tsam yod pa'i phyir| sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar na sku'i ngo bo thob pa yod de| chos nyid mngon sum gyis rtogs shing sa bon 'ga' zhig spangs pa yod pa'i phyir| sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar sku'i rigs rdzogs pa yod de chos nyid mngon sum gyisartogasapa rgyun mi chad yod cing nyon mong mngon 'gyur skye mi srid pa yod pa'i phyir|</seg></TEI>
